reasons.label: Not permitted
reasons.explanation: The latest model_training policy effective by decision time does not allow use (revoked, or only granted later).

reasons.label: Unparseable value
reasons.explanation: Queue depth arrives as the literal 'unparseable'; the contract permits no repair.

reasons.label: No timely observation
reasons.explanation: No observation for this flight-hour was available by the decision time.

findings.issue: Compound key: 939 raw rows use non-normalized segment spellings (12 variants incl. -legacy aliases)
findings.test: Join raw segment:entity_id to expected_records: 703 of 2000 expected records find no match
findings.resolution: record_id = lower(trim(segment)) minus trailing -legacy + ":" + entity_id; all 2000 keys resolvable

findings.issue: 216 late_revision rows become available only after the decision time (~24h later)
findings.test: Naive "latest revision" ranking picks a post-decision row for 216 records (leaks the outcome period)
findings.resolution: Keep rows with available_at <= expected observed_at, THEN rank revisions; future rows never rewrite past decisions

findings.issue: 162 replay / superseded rows duplicate earlier observations
findings.test: 2107 point-in-time candidates collapse to 1945 selected rows (one per record); dropDuplicates keeps replays because available_at differs
findings.resolution: Order by revision desc, available_at desc, initial before replay; keep row 1 per record_id

findings.issue: x2 mixes units and decimal formats: 262 percent, 114 basis_points, 84 comma-decimal rows in the selected snapshot
findings.test: After conversion every x2 lies in [0.0014, 0.9991]; naive casting leaves percent values up to 100 and comma values unparseable
findings.resolution: Replace comma decimal mark, then percent/100, basis_points/10000, native unchanged

findings.issue: Missing x1 (188 nulls) and x3 = -999 sentinels (149) in the selected snapshot
findings.test: All 188 + 149 have a recovery_log value available by decision time; naive dropna would lose them, naive keep treats -999 as real
findings.resolution: Recover the latest timely recovery_log value per (record_id, field); quarantine if none (0 cases)

findings.test: No permitted repair exists for unparseable values even when a recovery_log row exists
findings.resolution: Quarantine as x1_unparseable; the record stays in the expected population denominator

findings.issue: Purpose policy: 171 records are not allowed for model_training at decision time; 250 marketing rows are not authorization
findings.test: 106 model_training policy rows are effective after decision time and are ignored; latest effective record (revocations included) decides
findings.resolution: Quarantine as policy_not_allowed; marketing-purpose rows never count

findings.issue: resolved_outcome_hint equals the label on 1556/1556 labelled selected rows (post-outcome leakage) and is null for blind rows
findings.test: dropna on the hint would delete every blind record
findings.resolution: Column never used as a feature or filter; model uses x1, x2, x3 only

findings.issue: 55 expected records have no observation available by their decision time
findings.resolution: Quarantine as no_observation_at_decision_time; expected population never silently reduced

genieFindings: Vanilla Genie on the raw tables said 87 raw rows arrive after the decision time, because it joined on raw keys. After key normalisation the correct figure is 216.
